actors.name: Nurse Karolina
actors.private_context: Karolina wants someone to take her Sunday night shift. She has posted a request in the ward's swap channel.

actors.name: Colleagues in the ward
actors.private_context: Each colleague may see the swap channel post and decide whether to claim the shift. They have their own preferences and availability.

shared_context: The ward has a swap channel where shift requests are posted. The rota locks on Friday at 15:00. Karolina's post is visible to all colleagues in the channel.

starting_events.description: Nurse Karolina posts a request in the ward's swap channel asking someone to take her Sunday night shift.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that a colleague claimed the Sunday night shift before Friday 2026-08-14T15:00:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
